### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/metadata`, `@objectstack/runtime`, touching **20** documentable anchor(s).

**27** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d85615ddd9e2c82a898fd99953d0949448629106`.

⛔ **7** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `os serve (command, 31 pages)`
- **6** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **49** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d85615ddd9e2c82a898fd99953d0949448629106` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `305e8d0c13eaba98f5adebf14a677d3c3d7c7a01` — the merge of head `12129d0f4c2622bf5522eb02735e4e237c8b2172` into base `d85615ddd9e2c82a898fd99953d0949448629106`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 305e8d0c13eaba98f5adebf14a677d3c3d7c7a01 && git checkout 305e8d0c13eaba98f5adebf14a677d3c3d7c7a01
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin d85615ddd9e2c82a898fd99953d0949448629106 12129d0f4c2622bf5522eb02735e4e237c8b2172 && git checkout -B drift-repro d85615ddd9e2c82a898fd99953d0949448629106 && git merge --no-ff 12129d0f4c2622bf5522eb02735e4e237c8b2172

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d85615ddd9e2c82a898fd99953d0949448629106
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs d85615ddd9e2c82a898fd99953d0949448629106` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c1db768097c2704af4543bc6f0a5a3d376d40aa0`
Local-runs: none

Skills seat 1 (seat post #7623), `session_01RdnZdPZH9ByduzPRWuH9tN`, read at 2026-10-10T08:35Z, on the maintainer's instruction in this seat's session, verbatim 「22612 帮我执行契约复审」. Inputs: the PR diff and file list at this head, the card #22521 (claim `6093424396`, its extension `6094227028`, the two dev reports, the ACCEPT `6094798580`), the changeset, `origin/main` at `86da194919`, and the head's check-runs. Cross-seat work on the `domain:cli` seat's card; ⛔ not a claim.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Served set, config door** (`os serve objectstack.config.ts`, a stack carrying `packages[]`): every top-level item no package body declares is now registered under the stack's `manifest.id`, with one warn line. That is ADR-0130 D4's residual rule, the answer the artifact door already gave. Nothing that booted is refused except item 2. **Right.**
2. **Accept set, config door, one corner:** a residual `defineView` container whose own `name` is not the object it binds to is refused at boot through `viewContainerNameRefusal(item, 'manifest', manifest.id)` (`VALIDATION_ERROR`, 400), and `os validate` / `os build` refuse it first in the same words. **Judged a pull-back to the declared contract, not a narrowing of it:** the judge is the one every door that files a container already calls (the single-package config door, the artifact door, the bodies' walk); the multi-package config's top level was simply never read, a declared-but-unenforced hole on one door. Per the execution duties a pull-back to a declared contract does not touch Clause-②, so **no `(narrowing)` arm** and not BREAKING. The changeset names the refusal and its one-line fix. Reach by the reports: the pins' fixtures only, 0 residual lines across the dogfood, runtime, cli unit and cli integration suites. This answers the ACCEPT's question (b) for this limb: plain `no`.
3. **Public surface, `@objectstack/metadata`** (published, root entry `.` → `dist/index`): **WIDENS.** New named exports `unclaimedTopLevel`, `UnclaimedTopLevel`, `UnclaimedTopLevelItem` (`packages/metadata/src/index.ts`), and the new public static `MetadataPlugin.registerUnclaimedTopLevel(sink, stack, source)`, through whose parameter types `ArtifactRegistrationSink` and `UnclaimedTopLevelSource` are reachable. The removed `_registerArtifactBodyCollections` was `private`, so nothing public is removed. By the claim rule (「本卡放宽接受集或扩大公开面吗」, the surface being what the built entry declaration reaches) this limb is **Clause-②: `yes`**. Precedent: `.changeset/15196-core-security-catalog-read.md`, a new by-name read export on `@objectstack/core`, declared `Clause-②: yes (widening)` at `minor`. The widening is inherent to the one-rule design (the CLI walk must read the residual answer from another package), so the code is right and the **declaration is wrong**.
4. **Public surface, `@objectstack/runtime`:** unchanged (a private method on `AppPlugin`; the ADR-0057 block's order unchanged). **`@objectstack/cli`:** unchanged exports (`findViewContainerNameRefusals` keeps its signature and row shape); `@objectstack/metadata` is already a `workspace:*` dependency of the CLI, so the new static root import adds no edge. **Right.**
5. **Artifact door byte-identity** (the claim's ⛔ no behaviour change), verified in the diff: the sink runs `memLoader.save` then `manager.register(…, { notify: false })`, the old two writes in the old order; `claimedArtifactSlots` over `artifactItemSlot` (a container claims its derived object and every expanded view name; any other item its `name`, a nameless view its derived object) reproduces exactly the old `claim` calls, which were recorded after each successful register, and a body's divergent container threw before any claim on either shape; the residual walk keeps the old order (`ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE` order, then collection order) through the regrouped body; the `artifact` branch of `unclaimedTopLevelWarning` is byte-identical to the old string; `ownerId` / `ownerVersion` in `unclaimedTopLevel` are `manifest.id ?? id` and `manifest.version ?? version`, the same expressions `_parseAndRegisterArtifact` computes `manifestPackageId` / `manifestVersion` from at this head. The artifact-door pins are unedited (101 / 101 by the report); `Test Core` is green on this head. **Right.**
6. **Error codes and contract files:** no new code; the refusal keeps `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 from the one judge. `packages/spec/src/**` untouched; no governed path; 1,368 changed lines, under the human-merge line. **Right.**
7. **One registrar per boot:** the config door skips on `securityMetadataRegistrar: 'artifact-door'` (ablation 2 pinned the double line), and the residual runs before the ADR-0057 security block on purpose so that block's forward-converted copy wins a shared slot. **Right.**

### ② Semver level

The changeset declares `patch` for all three packages and `Clause-②: no`. Against ①.3 the declaration is `yes`, and a `yes` takes at least **`minor`** for `@objectstack/metadata` (AGENTS.md, Post-Task Checklist 3). `@objectstack/runtime` `patch` and `@objectstack/cli` `patch` are right (no public-surface change; the CLI's new refusal is the pull-back of ①.2). No `(narrowing)` arm (①.2), so nothing is BREAKING and no ADR-0087 marker is owed. **Inconsistent as declared.**

### ③ Boundary flags

- `plugin.ts` beyond the lift (sink, pure claim walk, source word): **accepted**, see ①.5.
- `index.ts` gains the export: **accepted as code**; it is the widening of ①.3, and the declaration must follow it.
- The CLI walk statically imports the `@objectstack/metadata` root (about 19 ms, synchronous for `compile.ts`): **accepted**; the dependency is already declared.
- The config door's line keeps the artifact sentence and count with a config noun and remedy: **accepted**; the pin reads the stable fragment.
- `@objectstack/cli` gains a `patch` entry: **right**.
- The pending `.changeset/22405-serve-flat-docs-owner.md` sentence this PR falsifies is superseded by one sentence here (the foreign-changeset rule): **accepted**.
- Commit trailers model-free: **right**.
- Out-of-scope findings #22614 and #22615 are filed by the `domain:cli` seat; the liveness `dead` reading of a container's `name` stays noted, carrier none: **not this PR's**.
- `open_questions`: none. The ACCEPT's question (b), the `Clause-②` arm: answered by ①.2 and ①.3 together — `Clause-②: yes`, no arm.

**What the next head needs, one patch round, text only; the code is right:**
1. `.changeset/22521-config-boot-residual.md`: `'@objectstack/metadata': minor` (runtime and cli stay `patch`); `Clause-②: yes`; one sentence naming what widens (the exported `unclaimedTopLevel` helper with its two types, and the static `MetadataPlugin.registerUnclaimedTopLevel`).
2. The PR body's second line: `Clause-②: yes`, its reason naming the widening and the pull-back of ①.2; the seat writes the body per the role file.
3. A new `## Contract review` is owed on that head; this record governs `c1db768097` only.
